objective: Preserve next_flow_ids in CachedScript and execute alert script chains with deduplication, cycle detection, and depth limiting.

acceptance.criterion: CachedScript preserves next_flow_ids when cached and retrieved.
eval_alert_scripts_chained chains execution to child scripts when root script fires.
eval_alert_scripts_chained detects cycles and evaluates each script at most once.
eval_alert_scripts_chained enforces MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH limit on long flow chains.
